_note: Hand-authored Effect Clauses the probe can't (fully) measure — each verified against the engine's own card text (cg.api all_card_data), never memory. Clause-level union by kind: an entry here replaces ALL measured clauses of its kind for that card (re-stamped after accumulation, apply_overrides). cardId -> [clauses]. 1229 Wally's Compassion (Supporter): 'Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokemon {ex}. If you healed any damage in this way, put all Energy attached to that Pokemon into your hand.' 1112 Super Potion: 'Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokemon. If you healed any damage in this way, discard an Energy from that Pokemon.' (probe measures this too — the override pins it). 1130 Arven's Sandwich: 'Heal 30 damage from your Active Pokemon. If that Pokemon is an Arven's Pokemon, heal 100 damage from it instead.' — two clauses, the 100-mode restricted arvens_pokemon. 1096 Poke Vital A: 'Heal 150 damage from 1 of your Pokemon.' — ACE SPEC (1 copy per deck), so the probe practically never reaches it AND HP_CHANGE caps at the damage present; this override is the shipped truth and doubles as a golden.
_note_gates: Conditional-gate heal tail (restriction = static target class; condition = dynamic board-state gate — see card_effects.py). 1105 Dragon Elixir (Item): 'Heal 60 damage from your Active {N} Pokemon.' — {N}=Dragon (engine-correlated: the set's Dragon mons have weakness None and Lillie's Clefairy ex, Psychic, sets {N} Weakness to {P}); probe-unreachable (no Dragon Active in probe boards) -> override-only. 1147 Jumbo Ice Cream (Item): 'Heal 80 damage from your Active Pokemon that has 3 or more Energy attached.' — probe measured the 80, the 3+-Energy gate is text-only. 1190 Bianca's Devotion (Supporter): 'Heal all damage from 1 of your Pokemon that has 30 HP or less remaining.' — printed amount is ALL; the probe's 250 was a capped observation of one body, the gate is the <=30-HP-remaining eligibility. 1241 Jacinthe (Supporter): 'Heal 150 damage from 1 of your {P} Pokemon.' — {P}=Psychic; probe measured the 150 (Psychic probe body), the type gate is text-only. 1242 Community Center (Stadium): 'Once during each player's turn, if they played a Supporter card from their hand this turn, they may heal 10 damage from each of their Pokemon.' — per-target 10 (amount = per-target magnitude, like Fennel), symmetric (either player), gate = played a Supporter this turn; probe-unreachable -> override-only.
